dataset_metadata.description: Curated multimodal threat analysis evaluation dataset containing ground-truth scenarios for suspicious messages, QR codes, PDFs, screenshots, and adversarial injections.
dataset_metadata.known_limitations: Synthetic benchmark for offline unit evaluation without live external internet calls; does not represent full open-world distribution.
